verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.2: Who can praise the greatness of Jehovah, when He speaks out all His words?
verses.3: He who keeps justice and does what is right at all times.
verses.4: May the LORD remember me with favor, and may He rescue me from your trials.
verses.5: To see with good eyes in your choices, to rejoice in the joy of your people, to dwell among your heritage.
verses.6: We have sinned with our fathers; we have been wicked.
verses.7: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your miracles. They did not remember your many blessings. Instead, they lied about it.
verses.8: And He saved them, so that their names might be known as a sign of His greatness.
verses.9: And he became angry in the sea of Sippo. He destroyed them, and threw them into the mountains like dust.
verses.10: And they were saved by one who hated them, and they were delivered from the hands of those who hated them.
verses.11: And the waters covered their enemies; one of them was not able to get out.
verses.12: And they believed in his words; they sang his songs.
verses.13: They forgot about his actions, and they did not wait for his advice.
verses.14: And there was a great disturbance in the desert, and they sought help from Yishimon.
verses.15: And He gave them their desires, and sent out their passions within them.
verses.16: And they became angry with Moses at the camp of Aaron, the Holy One of God.
verses.17: The earth will be opened, and its secrets will be revealed. It will cover the entire world.
verses.18: And fire burned among them, to burn the wicked.
verses.19: They will make a circle in the midst, and they will bow down to the Lord.
verses.20: And they exchanged their glory for a pot that can only be used to eat vegetables.
verses.21: They forgot their Savior, who did great things in Egypt.
verses.22: Glorious things in a hot land, shining upon the Sea of Sefi.
verses.23: And he said, “Let them be destroyed.” Moses stood before him in his own power, trying to restore order from the chaos.
verses.24: And they lived in a land of heat, and they did not believe his words.
verses.25: And they were killed in their tents, without hearing the voice of Jehovah.
verses.26: And he raised his hand to throw them into the pit.
verses.27: And let their seeds be scattered among the nations and in foreign lands.
verses.28: And they ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.29: And they became angry with their own actions, and a plague broke out among them.
verses.30: And Pinchas stood up and wept. And the plague was stopped.
verses.31: And it was considered righteous for him to suffer day after day, forever.
verses.32: And they quarreled among themselves, and it became bad for Moses because of them.
verses.33: For he poured out his spirit through his words.
verses.34: They did not destroy those nations whom Jehovah had spoken about.
verses.35: And they went into the nations, and learned from their actions.
verses.36: And they obeyed their desires, and they became their own masters.
verses.37: And they sacrificed their sons and daughters to the idols.
verses.38: And they shed innocent blood, the blood of their own children and their children who were sacrificed to the idols in Canaan. The earth became covered with blood.
verses.39: And they covered their actions with their own actions, and they committed evil deeds in their own ways.
verses.40: And Jehovah struck his people, and he devastated their land.
verses.41: And they were given into the hands of nations, and they were ruled by those who hated them.
verses.42: Their enemies forced them to surrender, and they were captured under their own hands.
verses.43: Many times, they will be saved. But others will continue to do evil in their own ways.
verses.44: And he saw their suffering in their voices, as they heard their cries for help.
verses.45: And He remembered their covenant, and He comforted them with His great kindness.
verses.46: And he gave them over to mercy before all their return.
verses.47: May Jehovah our God save us and bring us out of these nations, so that we may worship You in Your holiness and rejoice in Your praise.
verses.48: Blessed is Jehovah, the God of Israel, from this world to the next. And all the people said, “Amen!”
